meta.title: Claim graph, adjudicated
meta.tagline: One paper's causal graph from K independent claim extractions, merged and flagged
meta.description: Edges of a per-paper causal graph built outside Metalens from K runs of a stated-claims extraction: one adjudication call maps the runs' variable wordings onto one variable set, a deterministic merge keeps every edge stated at least once and flags the ones the runs disagree on. Each edge carries its support (runs out of K), the runs' own wordings and signs, the exhibit cells it rests on, and evidence labelled by how many runs produced it. Review the flagged edges against the per-run evidence.

fields.name: k
fields.label: Runs
fields.help: how many independent extraction runs were merged

fields.name: edge_id
fields.label: Edge id
fields.help: the pipeline's id of this edge (V<cause>-><effect> over the paper's variable set)

fields.name: cause
fields.label: Cause
fields.help: the variable the paper says moves the effect — the adjudicated canonical wording across the runs

fields.name: effect
fields.label: Effect
fields.help: the variable the paper says is moved — the adjudicated canonical wording across the runs

fields.name: sign
fields.label: Sign
fields.help: the direction of the stated effect: + increases, - decreases, 0 no effect, ? the runs disagree or the paper is mixed

fields.name: direction
fields.label: Direction
fields.help: agreed when every run that states this edge points it the same way; conflict when a run reverses cause and effect

fields.name: support
fields.label: Support
fields.help: how many of the K runs state this edge, e.g. 3/3

fields.name: tier
fields.label: Tier
fields.help: unanimous: every run with one sign · majority: more than half · backed: fewer, but an exhibit backs it · contested: the runs disagree

fields.name: kind
fields.label: Kind
fields.help: causal (an identified effect) or descriptive/comparison as the stated claim was typed

fields.name: design_basis
fields.label: Design basis
fields.help: identified when the paper's design identifies this effect; else how the claim is backed

fields.name: design
fields.label: Design
fields.help: the identification design behind this edge (difference_in_differences, event_study, iv, …)

fields.name: flags
fields.label: Flags
fields.help: what the runs disagree on: existence (only some runs state the edge), sign, direction; empty when none

fields.name: headline_cells
fields.label: Headline cells
fields.help: ids of the exhibit cells (companion tables dataset) that carry this edge's estimates

fields.name: neighbours
fields.label: Neighbours
fields.help: the other variables this edge's cause or effect is linked to in the paper's graph

fields.name: run
fields.label: Run
fields.help: which extraction run this row comes from

fields.name: cause_wording
fields.label: Cause (as worded)
fields.help: how this run worded the cause

fields.name: effect_wording
fields.label: Effect (as worded)
fields.help: how this run worded the effect

fields.name: run_sign
fields.label: Sign
fields.help: the sign this run gave the edge

fields.name: run_direction
fields.label: Direction
fields.help: this run's direction of the edge

fields.name: claims
fields.label: Claims
fields.help: the run's claim ids behind the edge
